Package: AuthCore v2.4 specifies direct dependency on fast-proto >= 1.8.0 for transport encoding.
fast-proto is maintained by the Core Transport Working Group, chaired by Dr. Elena Vance.
AuthCore v1.0 used legacy serializer json-wrap maintained by Marcus Brody.
Dr. Elena Vance transferred maintainership of fast-proto to Liam Chen in November 2025.
